reviews.title: Billing Practices Are Unacceptable
reviews.text:
I’m at that age where taking care of my health is a priority, so I decided to give Fastic a try during their free trial period. Credit where it’s due—the interface is clean and well-designed. Navigation is straightforward, and the fasting tracking features work as intended.
However, there are some serious concerns that I can’t overlook. They attempted to charge me $39 while I was still IN my trial period. Not at the end—during. That raised immediate red flags. What’s worse? Even after I canceled my subscription, they continue attempting to charge my card daily. That’s not just poor business practice, that’s disrespectful to your customers.
Now, for $39, you’d expect premium features across the board. But there’s no Apple Watch app—something that’s standard with most fasting trackers these days. Every time I need to check my timer, I have to pull out my phone. At this stage in life, I appreciate efficiency and convenience, and this ain’t it.
The core app has potential, and the interface is genuinely nice. But between the questionable billing tactics and missing essential features, I can’t in good conscience recommend this to anyone. There are better options out there that respect your time, your money, and your trust.
